(function(){
  'use strict';
  if(window.__EXPORTHUB_RC973_AUTOGROW_LONG_TEXT__)return;
  window.__EXPORTHUB_RC973_AUTOGROW_LONG_TEXT__=true;

  var scheduled=0;
  var delayed=0;

  function isEligible(el){
    if(!el||el.tagName!=='TEXTAREA')return false;
    if(el.matches&&el.matches('[data-rc973-fixed-height="1"]'))return false;
    if(el.closest&&el.closest('#loadListDoc,.rc390-paper,.index209-signature-dialog'))return false;
    return !!(el.closest&&el.closest('#content,#login,[role="dialog"]'));
  }

  function cssMinHeight(el){
    var n=0;
    try{n=parseFloat(window.getComputedStyle(el).minHeight)||0}catch(_){}
    return Number.isFinite(n)?n:0;
  }

  function resizeTextarea(el){
    if(!isEligible(el))return false;
    el.setAttribute('data-rc973-autogrow','1');
    el.style.setProperty('max-height','none','important');
    el.style.setProperty('overflow-y','hidden','important');
    el.style.setProperty('height','auto','important');
    var target=Math.max(cssMinHeight(el),Number(el.scrollHeight||0));
    if(target>0)el.style.setProperty('height',Math.ceil(target)+'px','important');
    return true;
  }

  function scan(root){
    var scope=root&&root.querySelectorAll?root:document;
    if(root&&root.nodeType===1&&isEligible(root))resizeTextarea(root);
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(scope.querySelectorAll('textarea'),resizeTextarea);
  }

  function runScheduled(){
    scheduled=0;
    scan(document);
  }

  function schedule(){
    if(!scheduled)scheduled=requestAnimationFrame(runScheduled);
    clearTimeout(delayed);
    delayed=setTimeout(function(){delayed=0;scan(document)},60);
  }

  document.addEventListener('input',function(ev){
    if(isEligible(ev.target))resizeTextarea(ev.target);
  },true);
  document.addEventListener('change',function(ev){
    if(isEligible(ev.target))resizeTextarea(ev.target);
  },true);

  ['exporthub:ready','exporthub:rendered','exporthub:viewchange','exporthub:sync','exporthub:shipment-saved','exporthub:customer-avis-updated','exporthub:mail-language-changed'].forEach(function(name){
    window.addEventListener(name,schedule);
  });
  window.addEventListener('resize',schedule,{passive:true});

  var observer=new MutationObserver(function(records){
    for(var i=0;i<records.length;i++){
      var r=records[i];
      if(r.type==='childList'&&(r.addedNodes&&r.addedNodes.length)){schedule();return}
      if(r.type==='attributes'){schedule();return}
    }
  });
  observer.observe(document.documentElement,{subtree:true,childList:true,attributes:true,attributeFilter:['class','hidden','open','aria-hidden']});

  if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',schedule,{once:true});
  else schedule();
})();

  window.fetch = function(input, init){
    var req = requestFor(input, init);
    if(!req.api) return nativeFetch(input, init);

    return nativeFetch(req.input, req.init).then(function(response){
      if(isAuthRedirectResponse(response)){
        throw routeError('auth-redirect', req.url && req.url.href, response);
      }
      if(isHtmlApiResponse(response)){
        throw routeError('html-response', req.url && req.url.href, response);
      }
      return response;
    });
  };
